verse.defaultMessage: “They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to fellowship … and to prayer.”
verse.description: Acts 2:42, abridged, quoted in the footer of every page. Quote the verse as an established Bible translation in the language has it, inside the language's own quotation marks.

reference.description: The Bible reference under the quoted verse: the book, chapter and verse.

contact.description: The heading of the footer column with the address, phone number and email.

online.description: The heading of the footer column linking to the church's social media.

copyright.description: The copyright line. `year` is the current year, already written out.
